in_hebrew.name: Dinny
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Divine, God's Gift
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Dinny הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek, Dinny means 'Divine' or 'God's Gift'. It is derived from the Greek word 'deinos', which means 'wonderful' or 'marvelous'. This name is deeply rooted in Christian spirituality and can be given to a girl to symbolize the divine blessings she receives.
